description: Sent BEFORE the binary frames. Accepted: `totalBytes` is the whole file's size, `offset`/`length` the range that will follow (the whole file unless the request carried a range), `mtimeMs` the file's modification time as an integer number of milliseconds. Rejected: `ok:false` with `error` and no binary frame (shown in `file_download_response.rejected.json`): missing_path, not_found, not_a_file, unreadable, invalid_stream, stream_in_use, invalid_range, range_not_satisfiable, changed, no_free_stream. `stream` is present when the request carried a valid one; `changed` also carries the file's current `totalBytes` and `mtimeMs`.
